daily.title: Trump ally Jim Jordan elected House Republican leader after midterm defeat
daily.summary: Jim Jordan, a hardline ally of President Donald Trump, was elected US House Republican leader on Tuesday, defeating Steve Scalise 106-73 in a secret ballot, US media reported. He replaces Mike Johnson after Republicans lost both chambers of Congress in last week’s midterm elections and will lead the party’s opposition.

daily.title: US soldier arrested in Britain on suspicion of assisting Russian intelligence
daily.summary: UK police arrested a senior member of the US Army on Tuesday on suspicion of assisting Russian intelligence, adding that the arrest was not related to other counter-terror investigations. The 41-year-old man was detained near the city of Gloucester, west England, and remains in custody.

daily.title: Mobilisation étudiante : la tension monte d’un cran entre bloqueurs et présidents d’université

daily.title: Gaza : sept personnes, dont un adolescent, tuées par des bombardements et des tirs israéliens, selon les services de secours palestiniens

daily.title: French far right on track to secure €10 million loan for Le Pen's presidential campaign
